summary: Belden Inc. filed an 8-K to report the completion of its acquisition of Vistance Networks’ RUCKUS reporting segment (the "RUCKUS Acquisition") on July 1, 2026, pursuant to a Purchase Agreement dated April 29, 2026. To fund the transaction, Belden entered into a $1,850 million senior secured term loan credit facility maturing July 1, 2033, bearing interest at term SOFR + 2.25% or base rate + 1.25% p.a., with customary covenants. No per-share price, premium, or valuation details were disclosed. The Transaction is closed. What to watch: post-acquisition integration and debt-service metrics.
